name: ag_news_benchmark_roya_token
description: AG News is a news topic classification benchmark that measures a model's ability to assign one of four topic labels (World, Sports, Business, Sci/Tech) to short news article texts. It evaluates text classification performance on a balanced, widely used news dataset derived from AG's news corpus. The dataset is commonly used as a standard baseline for text classification models.
reputation: Well-known, widely used benchmark for text classification and baseline comparisons in NLP research.
